assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Innbase editorial blog illustration, reusable transparent cutout, landscape 4:3 canvas at 1536x1152.
Primary request: A sophisticated, quiet 2D isometric illustration for "Seven places hotel revenue leaks and how to check each one", written for Nigerian hotel owners.
Subject: a small boutique hotel facade with three upper windows and a sheltered entrance, next to an open paper accounts ledger and a shallow receipt tray. A short trail of three small muted apricot coin discs has slipped through a narrow gap between the ledger and tray. One simple magnifying glass rests partly over that gap, suggesting careful checking, not blame. Make the hotel the main identifiable silhouette. Maximum four object groups; no people.
Style/medium: Flat editorial vector-style 2D isometric drawing. Precise architectural silhouettes, broad clean color planes, slightly softened corners, subtle fine paper-grain texture only inside the filled shapes. Depth comes ONLY from simple parallel isometric edges and two or three flat tonal faces. Quiet, assured, beautifully composed; NOT a 3D render, no photorealism, no glossy clay or plastic.
Composition: Entire compact still-life fully visible, centred with at least 12% clear space on every side. All objects sit on ONE visible low, thin isometric floor plane, a muted pale sage parallelogram. Short crisp directional shadows are contained within the floor. Keep everything in one connected composition, no floating icons, no frame, no circles or background blob.
Palette: neutral warm ivory #eee9dc, stone #d2d2c7, muted sage #a8b6a0, moss #74856d, forest #344b3f; sparse desaturated apricot #d4b08a only on the coins. Low saturation, coordinated tones, no white highlights or pitch-black outlines. Intended to blend into Innbase's paper #edf0e8 and forest green #101714 site backgrounds; illustration supports the typography elsewhere.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the floor and objects. No backdrop, no colored rectangular canvas, no checkerboard pattern baked into the pixels. Preserve the complete floor and clean anti-aliased edges.
Text: absolutely no text, letters, numerals, currency symbols, brand names, logos or watermark. Ledger uses only short non-readable lines.
Deliver a polished original brand illustration, calm and minimal, with a clear visual metaphor at thumbnail size.

Compose to remain clear at a small blog-card size; maximum four subject groups, lots of calm space. Keep portrait-like dimensional effects restrained; the illustration should support the article headline.

Subject: A hotel restaurant's payment matching routine: a small upright sage card-payment terminal with a blank inset screen stands beside TWO identical-size warm ivory paper receipts. Their short abstract printed lines align like a matched pair, joined by a modest sage check-mark token resting flat between them. A simple restaurant plate with folded cloth napkin sits just behind the receipts to establish restaurant context. Small, intentional and well balanced. No smartphone app interface, no readable amounts, no floating coins. The matched records are the clear focal point.

Subject: Counting a hotel bar's stock: one low open bar shelving cabinet holds exactly SIX simple unbranded bottles in two tidy rows of three, all evenly spaced. A small bottle on the lower shelf is subtly lighter than the others to suggest checking an open bottle, not an empty slot. Make the shelf compact, beautiful, uncluttered, with accurate straight geometry. No drinks, scattered objects or humans.
